# Rollback Drill Decision: Atlas Rehearsals

**Date:** 2026-07-02
**Participants:** Quinton Fairweather (CTO)

Quinton: "Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on. A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have."

Key decisions:
- **Cadence**: monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals
- **Owner**: Quinton Fairweather

segments.exact:

segments.note: Quinton establishes a mandatory recurring practice; the second sentence justifies the directive with an assertive rationale, kept together as one move.

Editorial record naming the owner; no textual ratification marker present, principal null by rule.

we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring future cadence and frames an untested rollback as a hypothetical absence — a general principle rather than a specific event.
Scheduling note names a concrete recurring activity set in the future; the cadence is planned rather than already realized.
Assigns a named individual as current owner — a settled present fact about a specific person.

evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: A directive that sets cadence by fiat and frames non-compliance as loss of capability — hierarchy enacted through command and consequence.
Records the mandated cadence as a fixed attribute — the directive's authority preserved in summary form.
Assigns a single named owner — rank-based allocation of responsibility, the directive's hierarchy made concrete.

evidence.quote:

observations.why: Frames rehearsal as the condition for genuinely possessing a capability — security through verified readiness, mastery through practice.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating possession of a capability with having rehearsed it — so that unrehearsed readiness counts as no readiness at all?

evidence.quote:

we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive sets a recurring process by positional authority while the aphoristic second sentence reframes the absence of rehearsal as absence of capability itself — an appeal to a value (readiness) to motivate compliance.
Records the decided cadence as a fact — controlling the informational record of what was established, no influence attempt on an audience.
Assigns ownership to a named individual — an act of positional authority allocating responsibility, not an influence attempt on an audience.

mints.name: MandateByAphorism
mints.title: a directive sealed with a maxim that reframes non-compliance as self-negation
mints.frame: Is the authority here being asserted not just by rank but by crystallizing the rule into a maxim that makes non-compliance sound self-defeating?

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic warning framing carries urgency-as-worry: an unrehearsed rollback is declared equivalent to no rollback at all, pressing the case with alarm rather than calm statement.
Settled, matter-of-fact scheduling note delivered in neutral register — the satisfaction of a cadence now fixed, no urgency or alarm in the wording.
Flat attribution of ownership, no affective charge — the contentment of an assignment settled, low arousal and mildly positive.

mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker pressing urgency by equating what is unrehearsed with what does not exist?
